Having them as separate tasks makes this kind of flexibility easier to implement without altering the core logic significantly.

In summary, while it may seem redundant at first glance, separating "ExtractFirstPenguinName" and "ReadTableHeader" into distinct tasks enhances modularity, reusability, clarity, error handling, and future flexibility.
